title: Enlightenment 0.28.0 Release
content_html:
Enlightenment 0.28.0 Release

  • 2026-10-31 - by Carsten Haitzler

This is the latest release of Enlightenment.

  • Added initial NetBSD support, including power commands and signal handling.

  • Added a NetworkManager module supporting Wi-Fi, Ethernet, Bluetooth networking, and VPNs.

  • Added automatic detection of NetworkManager and ConnMan network services.

  • Added network signal strength, security indicators, connection details, and tooltips.

  • Added saved connection management and forget buttons to NetworkManager and ConnMan.

  • Added NetworkManager traffic indicators, threaded polling, and configurable polling intervals.

  • Added VPN import, username prompts, authentication messages, and remembered form fields.

  • Added connectivity callbacks and captive portal login URL refresh handling.

  • Modernized NetworkManager dialogs, connection lists, Wi-Fi controls, and theme integration.

  • Fixed NetworkManager startup detection, suspend/resume dialog spam, and stale VPN indicators.

  • Fixed NetworkManager memory safety, D-Bus lifecycle, shutdown races, and popup refresh loops.

  • Added native PipeWire mixer support alongside PulseAudio.

  • Added mixer actions to select audio outputs and cycle between sinks.

  • Improved mixer event handling, popup keyboard controls, and missing-output error handling.

  • Added an integrated clipboard history module with configurable persistent history.

  • Modernized clipboard popups with themed controls and individually removable history entries.

  • Improved clipboard content tracking, selection timing, startup, shutdown, and configuration handling.

  • Restored the Pants module with skirts, kilts, lederhosen, malloc variants, and translations.

  • Added battery charge limits and remembered maximum charge settings per battery.

  • Moved battery and AC polling into a worker thread.

  • Removed the obsolete battery helper, fixed BSD builds, and capped displayed battery health at 100%.

  • Added ACPI CPU power profile support and handling for all kernel-provided options.

  • Matched AMD GPU power settings to CPU power levels.

  • Extended CPU polling intervals and reduced polling while displays are off.

  • Fixed CPU frequency gadget startup, sizing, and gradient rendering.

  • Fixed deferred suspend handling and unnecessary powersave wakeups.

  • Enabled process priority adjustments through the system helper without requiring `CAP_SYS_NICE` on Enlightenment.

  • Improved process statistics CPU accounting, formatting, layering, and window-change handling.

  • Fixed process statistics shutdown waits and invalid polling wakeups.

  • Added configurable X11 keyboard repeat rate and delay.

  • Added a smooth “Roll Up” window shading transition.

  • Added window actions for always-on-top, always-below, and normal stacking.

  • Fixed fullscreen layering, focused dialog stacking, and remembered window stacking.

  • Fixed maximization for client-side decorations and windows maximized at startup.

  • Fixed shaped input regions and mouse handling for borderless and fullscreen windows.

  • Fixed pointer focus selection and prevented pointer warping during mouse drags.

  • Fixed client tracking cleanup, icon double frees, and graph/video object leaks.

  • Fixed monitor disconnect handling, CRTC shutdown, and virtual screen shrinking.

  • Fixed display startup black screens, duplicate zone updates, and canvas reconfiguration.

  • Improved display mode sorting and guarded Wayland canvas updates during startup.

  • Removed per-desktop and per-screen profile support.

  • Fixed DDC display rediscovery, fuzzy EDID matching, library compatibility, and XDG paths.

  • Improved backlight filtering to exclude unsuitable LED devices.

  • Fixed gadget dragging, positioning, ordering, sizing, and mouse event handling.

  • Prevented unintended shelf gadget detachment and improved autoscroll behavior.

  • Fixed delayed gadget popups and improved Escape-key and mouse-wheel handling.

  • Improved taskbar and IBox refill behavior and live previews of minimized windows.

  • Fixed IBar launch indicators, fullscreen animations, popup handling, and orientation.

  • Avoided unnecessary IBar layout updates when the gadget only moves.

  • Improved window switcher layout performance and allowed operation without a mouse grab.

  • Fixed Bluetooth daemon restart crashes, disappearing devices, and immediate unpairing.

  • Improved Bluetooth adapter controls and battery icon restoration after reconnecting.

  • Fixed notification callback lifetime issues and popup reshuffle use-after-free errors.

  • Fixed system tray and D-Bus menu reference counting and memory access.

  • Fixed music-control shutdown cleanup and inhibition cleanup on message bus shutdown.

  • Fixed file manager monitor cleanup, null action lookups, and Everything substring matching.

  • Hid application menu and shortcut actions when desktop entries are unavailable.

  • Changed wallpaper selection to default to the current desktop and fixed custom lock-screen backgrounds.

  • Preserved existing Qt environment settings and corrected default launcher and tiling configuration.

  • Improved setup wizard cleanup and handling of missing keyboard layout rules.

  • Improved pixmap handling, X connection recovery, and nested Wayland compositor shutdown.

  • Started watchdog monitoring earlier and added environment overrides for watchdog and OpenGL use.

  • Restored Valgrind startup support and added suppressions for known false positives.

  • Added timestamped logging, improved signal diagnostics, and cleaned up debug output.

  • Fixed screenshot uploader output and ACPI file-descriptor cleanup.

  • Updated French, Italian, Japanese, and Portuguese translations and translation tooling.

  • Updated authors, copyright notices, dependency documentation, and build metadata.

  • Cleaned up compiler warnings, module headers, configuration code, and formatting.

Building and Dependencies

  2. libexif

  3. libpam (Linux only)

Highly recommended to ensure proper functionality (though you can live without these):

  1. connman (For network configuration support)

  2. networkmanager (For network configuration support)

  3. bluez5 (For bluetooth configuration and control)

  4. bc (For the everything module calculator mode)

  5. pulseaudio (For proper audio device control and redirection)

  6. pipewire (For proper audio device control and redirection)

  7. packagekit (For the built in system updates monitoring and updater)

  8. udisks2 (For removable storage mounting/unmounting)

  9. ddcutil (specifically libddcutil.so.2/3/4/5 for backlight control)

  10. gdb (If you want automatic backtraces on a crash in ~/.e-crashdump.txt - don't forget to build EFL and E with gdb debugging to make this useful)

Note: Enlightenment 0.28.0 depends on EFL v1.29.0 or newer.
